series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits mixed trend direction and weak seasonality with medium noise levels. High model performance variance and detected concept drift suggest a weighted combination strategy with dynamic error adaptation. Avoid ridge stacking due to unstable rankings and high noise, leveraging top 4 models with high regularization.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.6: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift present; ADE dynamic error weighting adapts to changing model performance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.top_k=4 AND series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high → use inverse RMSE weights with shrinkage and top_k=4 for regularization
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true AND series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high → ridge stacking overfits with few windows and concept drift
